title: Bernoulli restriction cost bound
statement:
Let $n \ge 1$, let $p \in \bbr$ satisfy $0 < p \le 1$, and let $w, s$ be positive integers. Let $\mathrm{event}$ be a decidable predicate on restrictions of $n$ variables, and suppose that for every $k \le n$ its probability under the fixed-size restriction model $R_k$ satisfies
\[
  \Pr_{R_k}[\mathrm{event}] \le \left(\frac{5kw}{n}\right)^{s}.
\]
Then the probability of $\mathrm{event}$ under a Bernoulli($p$) random restriction satisfies
\[
  \Pr_{R_p}[\mathrm{event}] \le (10\,p\,w)^{s} + \exp\!\left(-\frac{n\,p}{3}\right).
\]
